female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
female-nwtf-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference previous successful loan cycles with NWTF are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

female-repayment-promise-slower.body: Female borrowers who include an explicit promise to repay the loan may fund more slowly.

female-soil-pests-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention improving soil fertility or protecting crops from pests may fund more slowly.

female-self-labeling-deserving-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly label themselves as deserving or strong candidates for support may fund more slowly.

female-dreams-hopes-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly mention dreams or hopes for the future may fund more slowly.

female-marital-status-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention their marital status or spouse may fund faster.

female-currency-nwtf-slower.body: Female borrowers who specify loan amount in PHP and mention NWTF may fund more slowly.

female-credit-history-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly mention a good credit history may fund faster.

female-physical-items-slower.body: Female borrowers who list specific physical items to be purchased may fund more slowly.

female-food-security-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention food security in their pitches may fund faster.

female-children-count-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify the exact number of sons and daughters may fund faster.

female-specific-tools-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention purchasing specific tools or devices may fund more slowly.
female-specific-tools-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specificity in required inputs (seeds, chemicals) accelerates funding.

geographic-biographical-specificity-slow.title: The inclusion of detailed local geography or personal biographical narratives about upbringing is associated with slower funding for both men and women.
geographic-biographical-specificity-slow.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim.

female-currency-lender-slower.title: Pitches from women that specify the loan amount in PHP and explicitly name the lender NWTF are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-currency-lender-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim.

female-spouse-employment-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their spouse's employment may fund faster.
female-spouse-employment-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning a husband or being married is associated with slower funding.

female-children-details-slower.title: Female borrowers who include specific details about children or dependents may fund more slowly.
female-children-details-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific goals for children's education accelerate funding.

female-education-level-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention being high school graduates may fund faster.
female-education-level-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that education level is associated with slower funding.

female-biographical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who include specific biographical details like age and number of children may fund faster.
female-biographical-specificity-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that borrower age is associated with slower funding.

female-marriage-mention-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly mention their husband or marital status may fund more slowly.
female-marriage-mention-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that marital status or spouse mention is associated with faster funding.

female-education-independence-faster.title: Pitches from women that specify concrete goals for children's education or the pursuit of financial independence accelerate funding.
female-education-independence-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim.

female-age-children-slower.title: Female borrowers who include their age and number of children fund more slowly.
female-age-children-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific details about children (age, school status) accelerate funding.
